name: YouTrack for Orca
description: Browse YouTrack issues in the right sidebar and start coding agents on them.

settings.title: Default query
settings.description: YouTrack search query used when a server is first opened, before any search there.

settings.title: Branch name template
settings.description: Name of the new workspace and branch.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: Agent id preselected in the Start view; empty means terminal only.

settings.title: Start agents without a prompt
settings.description: Start the agent with no prompt, waiting for you in its terminal. Changeable for each start in the Start view.

settings.title: Include issue description
settings.description: Whether the "Include issue description in prompt" switch starts on in the Start view.

settings.title: YouTrack CLI path
settings.description: Leave empty to find the YouTrack CLI automatically.
